meta.title: 拍照姿势一定要选对‼️
meta.title_en: You Have to Choose the Right Pose!!
meta.topic: 拍照教学 · 姿势选择

scenes.title_cn: 回头照：给四分之三侧脸
scenes.title_en: Look-Back Shot: Give Three-Quarters of the Profile
scenes.context: 不是这样拍回头照的，是身子朝前慢慢回头，给到四分之三的侧脸。回头照的核心是身子朝前、慢慢回头。语域：拍照教学，错对对比。
sentences: That's not how you shoot a look-back photo.
Face forward and slowly turn your head back.
paraphrase: 回头照 → look-back photo / glance-over-the-shoulder shot
四分之三侧脸 → three-quarter profile / three-quarter angle
scenes.speak: That's not how you shoot a look-back photo. Face forward and slowly turn your head back. Offer a three-quarter profile.

scenes.context: 不是这样蹲着拍的，是微微侧身，眼神往下看。蹲姿拍照的关键是侧身+眼神往下看。语域：拍照教学，错对对比。
sentences: That's not how you shoot while squatting.
Slightly turn your body to the side.
Cast your eyes downward for a slimmer face.
paraphrase: 蹲着拍 → squatting shot / crouching pose
眼神往下 → cast eyes down / look downward
scenes.speak: That's not how you shoot while squatting. Slightly turn your body to the side. Cast your eyes downward for a slimmer face.

scenes.title_en: Standing Shot: Hand on the Hip
scenes.context: 不是这样站着拍照的，是手拿胯、一只脚往前伸。站姿拍照的关键是手放胯上、一脚前伸。语域：拍照教学，错对对比。
sentences: That's not how you shoot standing up.
是手拿胯，一只脚往前伸。
Place a hand on the hip and extend one leg forward.
Balance your weight and the pose looks natural.
paraphrase: 手拿胯 → hand on the hip / palm on the waist
hand on hip · palm on waist
脚往前伸 → extend a leg forward / step out
scenes.speak: That's not how you shoot standing up. Place a hand on the hip and extend one leg forward. Balance your weight and the pose looks natural.

scenes.title_en: Half Shot: Pretend to Touch the Hair
scenes.context: 不是这样拍半身照的，是假装摸头发，微微歪头。半身照的关键是摸头发+微微歪头。语域：拍照教学，收尾。
sentences: That's not how you take a half-body shot.
Tilt your head slightly for a livelier look.
paraphrase: 假装摸头发 → pretend to touch the hair / fake a hair fix
微微歪头 → tilt the head slightly / a gentle head tilt
scenes.speak: That's not how you take a half-body shot. Pretend to touch your hair. Tilt your head slightly for a livelier look.

practice: Face forward, slowly turn your head back, and offer a three-quarter profile.
Slightly turn aside and cast your eyes downward.
Place a hand on the hip and extend one leg forward.
Pretend to touch your hair and tilt your head slightly.
pitfalls: Face forward and slowly turn your head back.
「身子朝前回头」是 face forward, turn your head back。
Place a hand on the hip.
「手拿胯」用 hand on the hip。
「假装摸头发」用 pretend to touch your hair。
shifts: 用 that's not how you shoot…（不是这样拍）开头做错对对比
用 three-quarter profile（四分之三侧脸）、slightly turn（微微侧身）
用 balance your weight（重心放稳）、livelier（更灵动）、slimmer face（显脸小）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：四分之三的侧脸、微微侧身、手拿胯、脚往前伸、假装摸头发、微微歪头、显脸小、重心等。
